arc.canonicalText: She was nearly forty when she looked for a dress for her own wedding. After years of working in fashion, she wanted something simpler than the gowns she found. The search left her dissatisfied.

arc.canonicalText: Earlier, she had wanted the top editorial job at the magazine where she worked. She later recalled needing to recover when she realized she would not get it. She had stayed for sixteen years.
